tbesh_html:
1) to separate, set free, remove, open, escape, burst through
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to remove (oneself), escape
1a2) to set free, let out

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to cleave or burst through, i.e. (causatively) to emit, whether literal or figurative (gape)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away.
